title: HECM Mortgage Insurance Premium and Origination Fee Rates
content:
Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loans carry an FHA mortgage insurance premium charged once at closing and again every year on the outstanding balance, and an origination fee charged at closing. The rates are the same on all six payout plans.

| | HECM Line of Credit | HECM Tenure Payment Plan | HECM Term Payment Plan | HECM Modified Tenure Plan | HECM Modified Term Plan | HECM Fixed-Rate Single Disbursement |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Upfront mortgage insurance premium at closing (percent of the maximum claim amount) | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| Annual mortgage insurance premium (percent per year of the outstanding balance, accrued monthly at one twelfth) | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 | 0.50 |
| Origination fee rate on the first 200000.00 of the maximum claim amount (percent) | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 |
| Origination fee rate on the part of the maximum claim amount above 200000.00 (percent) | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| Smallest origination fee (USD) | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Largest origination fee, whatever the maximum claim amount (USD) | 6000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000.00 | 6000.00 |

## Notes on the rates

- The annual premium rate is an annual figure: each month's premium is one twelfth of it applied to the balance.
- The origination fee never falls below the smallest fee nor rises above the largest fee shown, whatever the two percentage rates produce.
- Hypothetical: on a maximum claim amount of 150000.00 the two rates produce 3000.00, which lies between 2500.00 and 6000.00. On a maximum claim amount of 100000.00 they produce 2000.00, so the fee is 2500.00. On 500000.00 they produce 4000.00 plus 3000.00, that is 7000.00, so the fee is 6000.00.
